note: All ten words are masculine (le/l'), so there is no gender divider in this zoom.

items.label: le change
items.scene: A traveller with a green parrot on her shoulder pays coins through the brass window to EXCHANGE them, and waits for her CHANGE ("SHAHNZH").

items.label: le guichet
items.scene: A goose ("gee") in a green visor serves customers through the brass COUNTER WINDOW ("SHEH").

items.label: l'envoi
items.scene: A little blue van ("ahn-VWAH") carries a parcel along the counter, off on its DISPATCH to faraway lands.

items.label: le postier
items.scene: A smiling POSTAL WORKER ("pos-TYAY") in a navy cap sorts letters into a wire TIER of trays.

items.label: le philtre
items.scene: A white-bearded old wizard pours a magic PHILTRE through a coffee FILTER ("FEELTR") into a glass bottle.

items.label: le poinçon
items.scene: A tabby cat POUNCES ON ("pwan-SOHN") a metal PUNCH that leaves a hallmark STAMP on a silver spoon.

items.label: le colis
items.scene: A COLLIE ("koh-LEE") trots up with a PARCEL in its mouth.

items.label: l'expéditeur
items.scene: An explorer in a pith helmet, home from an EXPEDITION, hands his parcel over the counter: he is the SENDER ("ehk-spay-dee-TUHR").

items.label: le demandeur
items.scene: A moustached man holds up his slip and DEMANDS his parcel: a REQUESTER ("duh-mahn-DUHR") who will not wait.

items.label: l'emballage
items.scene: A girl ties ribbons on a heap of gifts in WRAPPING paper, piled up like BAGGAGE ("ahn-bah-LAHZH").
